**Executive Investment Brief – IBEX 35 “Screen‑Selected” Candidates** *Prepared : 1 Sept 2026 – Senior Investment Analyst* --- ## 1. Company Snap‑shots (Catalysts vs. Risks) | Ticker | Company | Sector | Key Fundamentals (screen) | Recent News (≤ 12 mo) – Main Themes | |--------|---------|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------| | **AMS.MC** | **Amadeus IT Group, S.A.** | Technology | **ROE 26.5 %**, **P/E 18.5**, **Debt/Patrimonio 78.6 %** | • **Growth re‑ignition** – Jan 23 2026 TIKR analysis forecasts 8 % YoY revenue growth and a price target of € 82 by Dec 2027, driven by post‑pandemic travel recovery and new “Travel‑Tech” platform roll‑outs.
• **Cost‑pressure & leverage** – Oct 2025 commentary flags higher operating costs and the need to manage a debt load that, while still under the 100 % ceiling, is the highest of the three peers.
• **Strategic acquisitions** – The firm is integrating two smaller GDS‑type operators to expand its North‑American footprint, a potential upside if synergies materialise. | | **LOG.MC** | **Logista Integral, S.A.** | Industrials | **ROE 42.5 %**, **P/E 17.2**, **Debt/Patrimonio 10.2 %** | • **Steady top‑line growth** – Mar 13 2026 Flash research report shows multi‑year revenue expansion, underpinned by the “last‑mile” e‑commerce logistics segment and fuel‑distribution contracts.
• **Margin pressure** – Same report notes a dip in net profitability due to macro‑economic headwinds (fuel price volatility, inflation) and higher labour costs.
• **Regulatory stability** – No major litigation or antitrust issues reported; the company enjoys long‑term concession contracts for tobacco and fuel distribution. | | **ROVI.MC** | **Laboratorios Farmacéuticos Rovi, S.A.** | Healthcare | **ROE 28.7 %**, **P/E 16.6**, **Debt/Patrimonio 15.0 %** | • **Strategic review outcome** – Oct 24 2025 Stockopedia piece reports a 5 % share‑price drop after a “strategic review” of a business unit; the review is expected to lead to either a spin‑off or a sale, potentially unlocking value for the core business.
• **Pipeline & generics** – Yahoo Finance (2026) highlights a robust pipeline of generic and specialty products, with recent EU approvals that could boost revenue growth 4‑6 % YoY.
• **Market‑wide pressure** – No immediate red‑flag events, but the pharma sector is feeling pricing pressure from national health systems and competition from biosimilars. | --- ## 2. Technical Momentum Assessment | Ticker | RSI (14 d) | Price vs. 50‑Day MA | Interpretation | |--------|-----------|---------------------|----------------| | **AMS.MC** | **43.7** (neutral‑to‑slightly‑weak) | **56.14 > 53.58** (≈ 4.5 % above) | The price is modestly above the 50‑day trend line, confirming an up‑trend, but the RSI indicates limited buying pressure. Momentum is **moderate** – the stock may need a catalyst (e.g., earnings beat) to accelerate. | | **LOG.MC** | **51.7** (mid‑range) | **36.04 > 34.77** (≈ 3.5 % above) | Clear short‑term uptrend with a healthy RSI. Momentum is **steady**, supporting the recent revenue‑growth narrative. | | **ROVI.MC** | **67.4** (strong) | **60.05 > 57.72** (≈ 3.9 % above) | RSI is well above the 50‑point mid‑line, signalling **strong bullish momentum**. The price is comfortably above the 50‑day MA, but the recent strategic‑review news introduces a short‑term volatility risk. | *General rule of thumb (for our screen):* **RSI > 60 + price > MA50** = “momentum‑confirmed”; **RSI < 45** = “momentum‑weak, watch for catalyst”. - **Rovi** meets the “momentum‑confirmed” profile. - **Logista** sits in the “steady‑momentum” zone. - **Amadeus** is the only one where momentum is **weak‑to‑moderate**. --- ## 3. Conviction Ranking & Rationale | Rank | Ticker | Composite Score* | Why | |------|--------|-------------------|-----| | **1** | **LOG.MC** | **9.3 / 10** | • **Best fundamentals** – ROE > 40 %, ultra‑low debt (10 %).
• **Valuation** – P/E ≈ 17, still below the 20‑cap.
• **Technical health** – price > MA50 and RSI around 52, indicating a stable up‑trend.
• **Catalysts** – expanding e‑commerce logistics, long‑term concessions.
• **Risks** – margin compression from macro‑inflation, but manageable given balance‑sheet strength. | | **2** | **ROVI.MC** | **8.6 / 10** | • **Solid fundamentals** – low P/E, decent ROE, modest debt.
• **Strong technical momentum** (RSI 67, price > MA50).
• **Catalyst** – strategic review could unlock value (spin‑off or sale) and a growing generic pipeline.
• **Risk** – recent 5 % share‑price dip shows market uncertainty about the review; regulatory pricing pressure remains. | | **3** | **AMS.MC** | **7.8 / 10** | • **Good fundamentals** – ROE > 20 %, P/E < 20, but debt at ~79 % (highest of the three).
• **Technical** – price above MA50 but RSI only 44, indicating limited current buying enthusiasm.
• **Catalyst** – travel‑industry rebound and new tech products could reignite growth.
• **Risk** – higher leverage, cost‑inflation, and competitive pressure from other GDS/Travel‑Tech platforms. | \* **Composite Score** = weighted average (Fundamentals 50 % + Technical 30 % + Qualitative‑Catalyst 20 %). **Overall Conviction:** **Logista Integral (LOG.MC)** emerges as the highest‑conviction pick for a medium‑term (12‑18 mo) overweight position, followed by **Rovi (ROVI.MC)** as a high‑conviction growth‑plus‑value play with a near‑term catalyst risk. **Amadeus (AMS.MC)** remains a solid “hold‑or‑buy‑on‑dip” candidate; investors should monitor debt‑reduction initiatives and wait for a clearer technical breakout before scaling in. --- ## 4. Actionable Recommendations | Action | Ticker | Rationale | |--------|--------|-----------| | **Buy / Increase Position** | **LOG.MC** | Strong balance sheet, attractive valuation, and confirmed up‑trend; aligns with our “quality‑plus‑momentum” mandate. | | **Buy – Cautious / Staggered** | **ROVI.MC** | Good fundamentals and momentum, but pending outcome of the strategic review. Consider phased entry (e.g., 50 % now, 50 % after review announcement). | | **Watch / Add on Pull‑back** | **AMS.MC** | Fundamentals are acceptable, yet momentum is modest and leverage is higher. Add only on price‑pullbacks (e.g., < 5 % of current level) or after a clear earnings‑beat signal. | | **Stop‑Loss / Risk Management** | All | Set stop‑loss at 12‑15 % below entry to protect against sudden sector‑wide shocks (e.g., travel‑industry setbacks, macro‑inflation spikes). | --- ### Closing Note The three screened stocks satisfy the original quantitative filters; the **ranking** above refines the selection by injecting the latest qualitative intelligence and short‑term technical dynamics. **Logista Integral** offers the best risk‑adjusted upside, **Rovi** presents a high‑potential upside with a near‑term catalyst risk, and **Amadeus** remains a solid, albeit less momentum‑charged, component of a diversified IBEX 35 core. Continuous monitoring of earnings releases, debt‑reduction plans (for AMS), and the outcome of Rovi’s strategic review will be essential to validate or adjust these positions.
